title: DCLink mission content version 1
description: Editable mission content, separate from the service-assigned mission ID and revision. Saving content does not authorize execution.
$comment: Service validation also rejects duplicate JSON object keys, non-finite decoded numbers, duplicate waypoint IDs, and documents larger than 262144 UTF-8 bytes. Execution requires at least one waypoint and independent readiness checks.

name.description: A label of 1–80 Unicode code points, without control characters or leading/trailing whitespace. Names are not mission identity.

altitude_reference.description: Metres above the admitted aircraft HOME altitude, not terrain clearance. HOME availability is checked before execution.

waypoints.description: Ordered route. Empty saved drafts are allowed. Waypoint IDs must be unique within the mission; the service checks ID uniqueness because JSON Schema cannot express uniqueness of one object property.

rules.description: Reserved for a later capability-gated schema. Version 1 accepts no rules.

areas.description: Reserved for a later capability-gated schema. Version 1 accepts no behavior areas.

id.description: Lowercase UUIDv4, stable through coordinate edits and reordering, and unique within this mission.

altitude_m.description: Finite metres relative to HOME. Configured flight altitude limits are checked separately before and during execution.

acceptance_radius_m.description: Finite positive metres for this waypoint. Editors initially offer 30 metres; execution must honor the saved value or reject unsupported behavior.
